cases.title: Persistent save-link registration failure is not propagated to unlink
cases.unsafe_mechanism: A final-link namespace removal can commit without a persistent save link. A crash before live eviction can therefore leave an unreachable zero-link inode outside save-link recovery enumeration.
cases.repair_contract: Propagate registration failure and prevent commit, prove rollback/abort, or enter failstop before unsafe success exposure.

cases.title: Mount ignores synchronous unfinished-unlink cleanup failure
cases.unsafe_mechanism: The synchronous save-link scan can report incomplete cleanup while reiserfs_fill_super continues to successful mount exposure with retained recovery work unresolved.
cases.repair_contract: Propagate mount failure, enter explicit failstop/read-only containment with retained responsibility, or prove deadline-safe delegation before exposure.

terminology_policy.allowed_claim: source-confirmed correctness bug under the frozen OIDS contract
